Phones and narrow screens
  • Below 900 px the TV stage turns into one scrolling column of cards, in the same order as on the TV.
  • Tabs become a scrollable pill row under a compact top bar that keeps the freshness chip.
  • Charts reflow: the journey tracker turns vertical, and wide charts keep their card at full width.
  • Minimum text is 14 px, with no sideways scrolling at 360 px.
  • No auto-cycling on phones: people scroll instead.
